d: Giant predators, mysterious catches and bizarre underwater sightings make these waters impossible to ignore! Jeremy Wade ventures into some of the world's most intriguing waterways, investigating extraordinary fish and unusual aquatic encounters. From catching a giant Pacific halibut in Alaska and tracking a seven-foot wels catfish to the mysterious Dusky Carp and the Giant Pike Menace, every expedition brings a new mystery. He also investigates killer whales hunting salmon and encounters remarkable species across Lake Garda and the Fitzroy River.
